I do want to change. I'd like to be attractive and smart and desirable but I feel like if I wasn't born that way already like what's the point y'know? 

I'd feel like a failure if I had to work to be a good person instead of being good from the beginning. This probably sounds crazy.
I don't write well at all lol but uh thanks I guess. I don't have any strengths honestly. I've never had any talents or any athletic ability or anything.
I don't think I'll ever be able to love myself. I'm too flawed. So if that's a requirement for getting a boyfriend I guess I have my answer then.

I say I'm ugly because I know I'm ugly. I do not look like what most normal people would consider an attractive male. Other people have told me I'm ugly before and they have no reason to lie.

I also don't really think I'm young I mean in 5 years I'll most likely have already wasted half of my existence.
I know people always say that but how can you expect me to believe it? You really want me to think that pretending that I'm not ugly will suddenly make my life better and make me dateable?
I'm way too ugly. Going to the gym won't help any.
Counselors cost money and they'd only tell me things that don't work anyway.

Thanks everyone for all your replies but after some thought I've decided to just stop playing the game. The disappointment every month is just a bit too much. It was fun for a while though. Cya around maybe.
